speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify your symptoms; can you tell me if you have experienced chills, nausea, or visible blood in your urine since the sinusitis treatment began? Also, how many days did the antibiotic course last, and which specific medication were you prescribed?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the fatigue, fever, and flank pain began after your sinus treatment, were you taking antibiotics for the sinus infection, and what specific medication was it? Please tell me the name of the drug and how many days you took it.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The progression from sinusitis to a rash on amoxicillin (suggesting allergy) followed by cephalexin, now presenting with fever, fatigue, and flank pain, is highly suggestive of a new urinary tract infection that has ascended to the kidneys. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine Culture.
